fortran_shape: evaluate_snow(parameters, committed_state, forcing, t0, t1, candidate_state, fluxes, results, diagnostics)

authority.f_pm_role: process data ownership and deterministic process evaluation only

parameters.name: swsublim
parameters.meaning: 0 enables sublimation from snowpack; 1 suppresses it

parameters.name: snowcoef
parameters.time_semantics: legacy comments and equations assume daily evaluation; generic scaling is not authorized by F-PM01

committed_state.name: snow_water_storage
committed_state.meaning: total snowpack water equivalent after evaluation, including retained liquid water

committed_state.name: liquid_water_storage
committed_state.meaning: retained liquid water in the snowpack

hydraulic_view.reason: B1.10 snow() does not read HeadCalc, h, theta, q, Jacobian or solver scratch.

excluded_from_process_state.name: snowinco
excluded_from_process_state.reason: integral.f90 resets snowinco=ssnow at balance-period reset; it is a water-balance/reference baseline, not physical continuation state

excluded_from_process_state.name: TePrRain/TePrSnow
excluded_from_process_state.reason: used by MOD_meteo to form gsnow/snrai, not by snow() task 2 itself

transaction_semantics.commit: F-KT copies accepted candidate state into committed state
transaction_semantics.rollback: discard candidate; committed state remains byte-identical
transaction_semantics.replay: same committed state plus same forcing must reproduce candidate and diagnostics
transaction_semantics.warm_start: not applicable to this algebraic process; no hidden solver iteration state

time_contract.target: generic interval identity is explicit and must never be inferred from midnight/day number
time_contract.known_hidden_assumption: B1.10 driver calls Snow(2) only when flDayStart, and snowcoef/flux variables are consumed without explicit dt multiplication
time_contract.fail_closed_rule: F-PM01 does not authorize duration scaling or subdaily reinterpretation. Production migration must obtain a qualified time-semantics decision/fixture before claiming generic-interval numerical equivalence.
time_contract.non_midnight_contract_test: contract data model permits non-midnight t0/t1 and does not branch on calendar fields, but numerical equivalence outside the legacy call domain is not claimed.

mass_accounting.reference_identity: candidate_snow_water_storage - committed_snow_water_storage = snowfall_input + rain_on_snow_input - sublimation - melt, up to floating-point roundoff
mass_accounting.hard_requirement: mass residual must remain bounded at floating-point roundoff for characterized cases

optional_state.inactive_snow: no snow process persistent state allocation in target kernel/runtime
optional_state.legacy_behavior: driver skips Snow calls when swsnow != 1

holds: No production source implementation in F-PM01.
No generic-time scaling inferred from daily legacy behavior.
No F-SI04 production dependency until an admitted production seam exists.
No F-PM02 production migration until a shared qualified downstream baseline exists.
